title.narrative: The Tourism Resilience Project

description.narrative: The Tourism Resilience Project focuses on helping Sri Lankas tourism recovery and resilience efforts through the following objectives: - Retain jobs and small businesses; - Support sustainability, innovation, and resilience through the development of new, more diversified tourism products; and, - Build SMEs that are aligned to those tourism products and better able to compete in the changing tourism landscape

comment.narrative: While the final value fell short of the final target the project was able to award some larger grants than originally anticipated including an additional 4 Economic Opportunity grants which are not included in the target for of SMEs.
